long_biography.plain_text:
De Graeve joined Immogra in the early 1990s alongside his twin brother Dirk, roughly a generation after their father founded the Belgian family developer. The brothers broadened its reach beyond the Ghent area and coastal projects of its early years. They extended activity into Antwerp and Brussels, while Frank took executive roles across the group's development, investment and holding companies.

Immogra now develops residential, office, retail and student housing, while affiliated companies own and manage property. Frank and Dirk jointly control REGO and operate the group through Service & Development Group Belgium. Frank's wider leadership portfolio includes Carlton, Divani, Green Park Investments and Dunant Invest. Carlton rents and operates property, while Divani and Dunant Invest focus on development, sales and leasing.
